subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM to substitute the underlined word in the given sentence.**

The newly selected secretary of the party has a/an __impeccable__ image among the public.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Blemished**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Impeccable **means flawless or perfect. (दोषरहित या परिपूर्ण)

 
 
• **Example**: *His suit was impeccable, without a single wrinkle or stain.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Blemished **means flawed or damaged. (त्रुटिपूर्ण या क्षतिग्रस्त)
